action: Preserved all original logs, fixed the implementation and tests, reran E0, and repeated the frozen calibration scan. The corrected run is reported separately in E1_report.md and decision_v1.md.
confirmed_findings: Segmented DOP853 reference and adaptive integration failed to advance state through intervals without report samples and used the last sampled state as the segment endpoint state.
A shared per-node token invalidated earlier queued input and neighbor events when any later event was pushed.
Local updates read current global neighbor states when integrating the target's preceding interval, rather than consuming only published local messages.
Untriggered output snapshots copied stale cached node values instead of predicting their trajectories.
B0 ran the sparse graph and duplicated B3 instead of using a dense graph.
B2 shared the proposed local-drift scheduling path and therefore did not implement the frozen input-event baseline.
The original T0-T6 suite did not exercise pulse segment advancement, input-event survival, long-horizon stability, or fallback numerical accuracy.
reason: Post-run code review found correctness defects in the oracle and event scheduler.
